macro_context.market_sentiment: Risk-off on May 4 2026: Dow -0.79%, S&P 500 -0.30%, Nasdaq -0.14% after UAE intercepted Iranian missiles and Iran threatened US forces near Strait of Hormuz; WTI crude surged 4% above $106/bbl and Brent +6% above $114. S&P 500 had hit new all-time highs in late April before today's flare-up.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% on April 29 (Powell's final FOMC meeting as chair). Most dissents since October 1992; SEP projects only 1 rate cut in 2026. Fed cited elevated inflation from global energy prices and 'high uncertainty' from Middle East conflict.

web_context.competitor_activity: AbbVie is aggressively expanding — secured a right-to-buy deal for Kestrel Therapeutics (pan-KRAS inhibitor) and a $5.6B licensing deal for RemeGen's RC148; projects combined Skyrizi+Rinvoq sales >$31B in 2026. Pfizer guiding for revenue decline in 2026 (~$59.5-62.5B, -2.5% midpoint) with EPS down ~9%. Merck faces Keytruda patent cliff in 2028 and is investing in US manufacturing. Overall Big Pharma M&A is booming in 2026, which may pressure JNJ to be more acquisitive or face competitive pipeline gaps. Medical device competitors (Medtronic, Boston Scientific, Abbott) continue to expand in surgical and cardiac segments.
